title: Queue Ledger Event
description: Structural schema companion for contract: durable-queue/v0. One line of the append-only NDJSON ledger. Queue state is a fold over these events. seq is monotonic per queue with no gaps and is the replay cursor. The fencing token never appears; the attempt number identifies the lease. Payloads never appear; enqueued carries a payload digest.

seq.description: Monotonic per queue, gap-free. A gap or regression is corruption.

type.description: Closed vocabulary. Unknown types are rejected by consumers that act on the ledger.

at.description: Broker clock, RFC 3339 UTC. Under a virtual clock this is deterministic.

attempt.description: Lease attempt number. Required on leased, extended, acked, nacked, lease_expired.

worker.description: Consumer identity on leased. May reuse a process-run run_id.

lease_until.description: Lease expiry on leased and extended.

not_before.description: On nacked when the message returns to ready; on enqueued when delayed.

idempotency_key.description: On enqueued when present; on deduplicated always.

payload_digest.description: On enqueued. SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical payload, or of the referenced artifact bytes when payload_ref is used.
